_comment: Second early-validation preview of the v0.10.0 capability wave, following the published v0.10.0-preview.1 tag at 784e877f39497fe80a2ae1befc8fc7ca5c7e244c. The actual candidate source is the merge commit of the reviewed preparation PR.
The next target is 0.10.0-preview.2: the repository's normal preview calculation increments the existing preview.1 tag, so the maintainer should use release_type=preview without version_override.

The candidate delta after preview.1 is the Architecture Health audit/applicability correction tracked by #1061. It prevents audit-only completion failures from failing strict applicability while retaining the audit evidence.

Preview.1 already shipped the v0.10 contract (#566), layered/DDD annotation sources (#569), and repository metrics/dependency-depth badge correction (#1057); they remain delivered context in this cumulative candidate, not new preview.2 work.

Open annotation package/catalog, additional role-family, context metadata, adoption guidance, and packed-consumer work remains excluded. In particular, #574 remains the required packed-artifact gate for final stable v0.10.0. This declaration authorizes exactly 0.10.0-preview.2 and no stable or other preview target.

required_items.summary: Keep audit-only applicability failures observable without allowing them to fail the strict Architecture Health gate

excluded_items.reason: The source-only annotation package distribution and integration of the complete approved annotation set remain open; this preview does not claim package adoption completion.
Canonical classifier integration remains open for package/catalog parity and full integration acceptance; the shared classifier seam shipped in preview.1 does not complete this work.
CQRS, messaging, and web/API annotation families are separate open v0.10 work and are not required for this early preview.
Infrastructure, UI, and Unity annotation families are separate open v0.10 work and are not required for this early preview.
The bounded semantic context metadata model remains open and is not claimed complete by this preview.
Annotation-first adoption, migration, compatibility, and AI-authoring guidance remains open and is not required for this early preview.
Packed external-consumer acceptance remains the release gate for stable v0.10.0; this preview does not claim that gate or stable release completion.

delivered_items.reason: The v0.10 semantic annotation contract was included in published preview.1; it is prior-preview context, not new preview.2 work.
Layered and DDD annotation sources were included in published preview.1; they are prior-preview context, not new preview.2 work.
The repository source metrics and Structure badge depth correction was included in published preview.1; it is prior-preview context, not new preview.2 work.
